§3§lOptional piece - but this one is the reactor.§r
An octagon of diameter 7 + 2 x tier, walls twice the diameter tall, on a hemispherical shield dome. Its FRONT face carries the main station and the six sockets the silo itself uses.

§eWALLS + DOME BY TIER§r
  §bT1§r (9 wide)   520x Radiation Proof + 113x Tungstensteel Reinforced
  §bT2§r (11 wide)  812x Radiation Proof + 193x Tungstensteel Reinforced
  §bT3§r (13 wide)  963x Europium Reinforced + 105x Radiation Proof + 257x Iridium Reinforced
  §bT4§r (15 wide) 1,343x Europium Reinforced + 129x Radiation Proof + 381x Iridium Reinforced
  §bT5§r (17 wide) 1,667x Radiant Naquadah Alloy + 141x Radiation Proof + 497x Iridium Reinforced
§8The Radiation Proof count at T3-T5 is the three radiation band rings, which stay radiation proof at every tier.§r

§eFUEL PILLARS§r - eight Reactor Fuel Columns each, full count per tier:
  T1 §b45§r pillars (360 blocks) . T2 §b77§r (616) . T3 §b109§r (872) . T4 §b157§r (1,256) . T5 §b201§r (1,608)
Partial pillars run at partial output.

§eTHE FRONT FACE§r - six sockets, one cell either side of the controller's column:
  §b1x§r Input Bus (IV) §8- rods in, bottom fuel course§r
  §b1x§r Output Bus (IV) §8- depleted rods out, same course§r
  §b1x§r Input Hatch (IV) §8- feedwater, drum course§r
  §b1x§r Output Hatch (IV) §8- waste water / exported steam, drum course§r
  §b1x§r Silo Control Block §8- between them§r
  §b1x§r Maintenance Hatch §8- beside the main station, pad level§r

§8Rod Loading Ports above the pillars are OPTIONAL - the rod bus feeds every pillar internally. A full set is 201 at tier 5 if you want them for hand-feeding.§r

[warn]MIGRATION - a plant raised by §b0.19.0 or earlier§r. Its silo FACE is the retired plumbing frontage: four Energy Hatches across the drum course and the buses out at the corners. That layout conflicts with the six sockets above §bcell for cell§r - each one puts a hatch where the other wants wall - so it fails at EVERY tier, and no projection can repair it: the projector MEASURES the shell that is standing and will not re-tier or overwrite it. The main station says so in as many words - §cTier N Steam Generator IS STANDING and does NOT pass its check§r - and the STRUCTURE ERRORS panel above that line carries the first wrong cell with its coordinates.[/warn]

[note]§6THE FIX IS ONE COMMAND.§r Stand beside the main station and run §b/btsmigrate§r §8(operator)§r. It reads the tier off the standing walls, then rewrites the front row's bottom three courses - the only cells the two layouts disagree about. Cells that are already right are left alone; wrong ones drop their contents at the wall as items before the correct casing or socket goes in, so every hatch you owned comes back with what was inside it. §bThe shell, the ribs, the dome, the pillars and the rods standing in them are never read and never written.§r Then it re-forms the plant and reports the tier, the cells rewritten and the machines handed back. Pick those up: the four Energy Hatches belong on the output manifold's back face now, and they are optional there.[/note]
